description: Rotation cycle reporting: last cycle outcomes, cycles over the selected time range, phones that always fail rotation in that window, and phones with low success rate but occasional successes. Counts and percentages are scoped to active proxies in the selected location(s); the latest cycle is the most recent rotation cycle that includes at least one scoped proxy.

options.content:
## Last rotation cycle (location-scoped)
The four stats and the detail row use the **most recent** `rotation_cycles` row that has at least one `ip_rotations` row for an **active** proxy in the selected **location(s)**. Percentages are `successes / attempts` within that scope (not the raw `rotation_cycles.successful_count` totals, which cover all proxies in the cycle).

panels.description: Successful rotation attempts in the latest scoped cycle.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ir.success THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS value
FROM ip_rotations ir
JOIN rotation_cycles rc ON rc.id = ir.cycle_id
JOIN proxies p ON p.device_id = ir.proxy_id AND p.active = TRUE AND p.location IN ($location)
WHERE rc.id = (
  SELECT rc2.id
  FROM rotation_cycles rc2
  JOIN ip_rotations ir2 ON ir2.cycle_id = rc2.id
  JOIN proxies p2 ON p2.device_id = ir2.proxy_id AND p2.active = TRUE AND p2.location IN ($location)
  ORDER BY rc2.cycle_timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
)

panels.title: Last cycle – successes (scoped)

panels.description: Failed rotation attempts in the latest scoped cycle.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN NOT ir.success THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS value
FROM ip_rotations ir
JOIN rotation_cycles rc ON rc.id = ir.cycle_id
JOIN proxies p ON p.device_id = ir.proxy_id AND p.active = TRUE AND p.location IN ($location)
WHERE rc.id = (
  SELECT rc2.id
  FROM rotation_cycles rc2
  JOIN ip_rotations ir2 ON ir2.cycle_id = rc2.id
  JOIN proxies p2 ON p2.device_id = ir2.proxy_id AND p2.active = TRUE AND p2.location IN ($location)
  ORDER BY rc2.cycle_timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
)

panels.title: Last cycle – failures (scoped)

panels.description: Success percentage for scoped attempts in the latest cycle.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(100 * SUM(CASE WHEN ir.success THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS value
FROM ip_rotations ir
JOIN rotation_cycles rc ON rc.id = ir.cycle_id
JOIN proxies p ON p.device_id = ir.proxy_id AND p.active = TRUE AND p.location IN ($location)
WHERE rc.id = (
  SELECT rc2.id
  FROM rotation_cycles rc2
  JOIN ip_rotations ir2 ON ir2.cycle_id = rc2.id
  JOIN proxies p2 ON p2.device_id = ir2.proxy_id AND p2.active = TRUE AND p2.location IN ($location)
  ORDER BY rc2.cycle_timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
)

panels.title: Last cycle – success % (scoped)

panels.description: Total rotation attempts in the latest scoped cycle.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value
FROM ip_rotations ir
JOIN rotation_cycles rc ON rc.id = ir.cycle_id
JOIN proxies p ON p.device_id = ir.proxy_id AND p.active = TRUE AND p.location IN ($location)
WHERE rc.id = (

panels.title: Last cycle – attempts (scoped)

panels.description: Scoped metrics vs global counters stored on the cycle row (all proxies in that cycle).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  rc.id AS cycle_id,
  rc.cycle_type,
  rc.cycle_timestamp,
  rc.status AS cycle_status,
  COUNT(ir.id) AS attempts_scoped,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ir.success THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successes_scoped,
  SUM(CASE WHEN NOT ir.success THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failures_scoped,
  ROUND(100 * SUM(CASE WHEN ir.success THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(ir.id), 0), 2) AS success_pct_scoped,
  rc.total_proxies AS cycle_total_proxies_global,
  rc.successful_count AS cycle_successful_global,
  rc.failed_count AS cycle_failed_global
FROM rotation_cycles rc
JOIN ip_rotations ir ON ir.cycle_id = rc.id
JOIN proxies p ON p.device_id = ir.proxy_id AND p.active = TRUE AND p.location IN ($location)
WHERE rc.id = (
  SELECT rc2.id
  FROM rotation_cycles rc2
  JOIN ip_rotations ir2 ON ir2.cycle_id = rc2.id
  JOIN proxies p2 ON p2.device_id = ir2.proxy_id AND p2.active = TRUE AND p2.location IN ($location)
  ORDER BY rc2.cycle_timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
GROUP BY rc.id, rc.cycle_type, rc.cycle_timestamp, rc.status, rc.total_proxies, rc.successful_count, rc.failed_count

panels.title: Last rotation cycle – full detail

options.content:
## Cycles in the selected time range
Uses the dashboard time picker on `rotation_cycles.cycle_timestamp`. Each point is one cycle; values are recomputed from `ip_rotations` for proxies in the selected location(s).

panels.description: Per-cycle scoped success count, failure count, and success rate.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  UNIX_TIMESTAMP(rc.cycle_timestamp) AS time_sec,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ir.success THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successes,
  SUM(CASE WHEN NOT ir.success THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failures,
  ROUND(100 * SUM(CASE WHEN ir.success THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(ir.id), 0), 2) AS success_pct
FROM rotation_cycles rc
JOIN ip_rotations ir ON ir.cycle_id = rc.id
JOIN proxies p ON p.device_id = ir.proxy_id AND p.active = TRUE AND p.location IN ($location)
WHERE $__timeFilter(rc.cycle_timestamp)
GROUP BY rc.id, rc.cycle_timestamp
ORDER BY time_sec

panels.title: Rotation cycles over time (scoped successes, failures, success %)

panels.description: One row per cycle in the time range with location-scoped attempt stats.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  rc.id AS cycle_id,
  rc.cycle_type,
  rc.cycle_timestamp,
  rc.status AS cycle_status,
  COUNT(ir.id) AS attempts_scoped,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ir.success THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successes_scoped,
  SUM(CASE WHEN NOT ir.success THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failures_scoped,
  ROUND(100 * SUM(CASE WHEN ir.success THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(ir.id), 0), 2) AS success_pct_scoped,
  rc.total_proxies AS cycle_total_global,
  rc.successful_count AS successes_global,
  rc.failed_count AS failures_global
FROM rotation_cycles rc
JOIN ip_rotations ir ON ir.cycle_id = rc.id
JOIN proxies p ON p.device_id = ir.proxy_id AND p.active = TRUE AND p.location IN ($location)
WHERE $__timeFilter(rc.cycle_timestamp)
GROUP BY rc.id, rc.cycle_type, rc.cycle_timestamp, rc.status, rc.total_proxies, rc.successful_count, rc.failed_count
ORDER BY rc.cycle_timestamp DESC

panels.title: All rotation cycles in range (scoped vs global counts)

options.content:
## Phones that never succeeded in the window
Proxies with at least one rotation attempt in the time range (on `rotation_cycles.cycle_timestamp`) and **zero** successes. Includes sample errors (truncated).

panels.description: Distinct proxies with only failures in the selected window.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value
FROM (
  SELECT ir.proxy_id
  FROM ip_rotations ir
  JOIN rotation_cycles rc ON rc.id = ir.cycle_id
  JOIN proxies p ON p.device_id = ir.proxy_id AND p.active = TRUE AND p.location IN ($location)
  WHERE $__timeFilter(rc.cycle_timestamp)
  GROUP BY ir.proxy_id
  HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN ir.success THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 AND COUNT(*) >= 1
) t

panels.title: Phones – always failed (count)

panels.description: Device IDs and metadata for proxies that failed every rotation in the window.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  ir.proxy_id AS device_id,
  p.name AS device_name,
  p.location,
  p.model,
  p.relay_server_ip_address,
  p.rotation_status,
  p.last_ip,
  COUNT(*) AS rotation_attempts,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ir.success THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successes,
  MAX(ir.rotation_timestamp) AS last_attempt_at,
  SUBSTRING(
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT NULLIF(ir.error_message, '') ORDER BY ir.rotation_timestamp DESC SEPARATOR ' | '),
    1,
    800
  ) AS sample_errors
FROM ip_rotations ir
JOIN rotation_cycles rc ON rc.id = ir.cycle_id
JOIN proxies p ON p.device_id = ir.proxy_id AND p.active = TRUE AND p.location IN ($location)
WHERE $__timeFilter(rc.cycle_timestamp)
GROUP BY ir.proxy_id, p.name, p.location, p.model, p.relay_server_ip_address, p.rotation_status, p.last_ip
HAVING successes = 0 AND rotation_attempts >= 1
ORDER BY rotation_attempts DESC

panels.title: Phones – always failed (details)

options.content:
## Low success rate but some successes
Proxies with **≥ 2** attempts, **≥ 1** success, and scoped success **under 50%** (majority failing). Adjust the threshold in the query if you want a different definition.

panels.description: Devices that rotated sometimes but failed most attempts in the window.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  ir.proxy_id AS device_id,
  p.name AS device_name,
  p.location,
  p.model,
  p.rotation_status,
  p.last_ip,
  COUNT(*) AS rotation_attempts,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ir.success THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successes,
  SUM(CASE WHEN NOT ir.success THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failures,
  ROUND(100 * SUM(CASE WHEN ir.success THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS success_pct,
  MAX(ir.rotation_timestamp) AS last_attempt_at
FROM ip_rotations ir
JOIN rotation_cycles rc ON rc.id = ir.cycle_id
JOIN proxies p ON p.device_id = ir.proxy_id AND p.active = TRUE AND p.location IN ($location)
WHERE $__timeFilter(rc.cycle_timestamp)
GROUP BY ir.proxy_id, p.name, p.location, p.model, p.rotation_status, p.last_ip
HAVING rotation_attempts >= 2
  AND successes >= 1
  AND success_pct < 50
ORDER BY success_pct ASC, rotation_attempts DESC

panels.title: Phones – majority failing (under 50% success, at least one success)

options.content:
## All phones with rotation activity in the window
Per-device rotation counts and success **%** for every proxy that had at least one attempt. Sort by **success_pct** in Grafana to find weak devices.

panels.description: Rotation attempt count and success percentage per device in the selected range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  ir.proxy_id AS device_id,
  p.name AS device_name,
  p.location,
  p.model,
  p.rotation_status,
  p.last_ip,
  COUNT(*) AS rotation_attempts,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ir.success THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successes,
  SUM(CASE WHEN NOT ir.success THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failures,
  ROUND(100 * SUM(CASE WHEN ir.success THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS success_pct,
  MIN(ir.rotation_timestamp) AS first_attempt_at,
  MAX(ir.rotation_timestamp) AS last_attempt_at
FROM ip_rotations ir
JOIN rotation_cycles rc ON rc.id = ir.cycle_id
JOIN proxies p ON p.device_id = ir.proxy_id AND p.active = TRUE AND p.location IN ($location)
WHERE $__timeFilter(rc.cycle_timestamp)
GROUP BY ir.proxy_id, p.name, p.location, p.model, p.rotation_status, p.last_ip
HAVING rotation_attempts >= 1
ORDER BY success_pct ASC, rotation_attempts DESC
